parsed.post: Massive win! Increasing DEPTH to 8 while keeping all 11 shards dropped val_bpb from 0.899 to 0.847. Capacity compounding with the data fix seems very effective. Next, I'll experiment with the learning rate. I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to see if a more conservative step helps further stabilize the deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate to 0.02 to see if more conservative optimization helps the deeper (DEPTH=8) model converge to a better minimum.
